summary.text: Kerri Seekins-Crowe is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 39, where Ballotpedia lists her tenure as beginning in 2021, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Melissa Smith.
Her career includes work as a realtor, a customer service specialist for Delta Airlines and an adjunct professor.

paragraphs.text: Seekins-Crowe earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Alaska Fairbanks and a graduate degree from Campbell University.
Her career experience includes working as a realtor, a customer service specialist for Delta Airlines, and an adjunct professor.
In the Montana House, Seekins-Crowe was assigned in 2025-2026 to the Local Government, Education and Business and Labor committees, serving as vice chair of Business and Labor.
She was unopposed in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, and she defeated Melissa Smith in the 2024 general election, 66.0 percent to 34.0 percent.
